extract_structure.input: assembly JSON bytes plus independently expected SHA256
extract_structure.output: canonical JSON bytes for five structure fields

prepare_joint.output: PreparedJoint; fixed full covariance, structure, rank and measure

evaluate_five.output: five pointwise normalized log integrals over d_eta; no prior integration/evidence

shape.identity_binding: ordered rows, eta column labels/units and full scale vector must match canonical hashes derived from pinned source metadata

array_encoding.array: exact numpy.ndarray, float64, fixed shape, finite; copied to <f8 C-order
array_encoding.bytes: raw float64 little-endian C-order; no header; exact byte length; no pickle/NPZ/HDF5
array_encoding.input_hash: sha256 of canonical native <f8 C-order bytes
array_encoding.row_ids_hash: sha256 UTF8 JSON list, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'), no newline
array_encoding.runtime_caps: No launcher or runtime cap claimed by pure API; external execution contract required

admission.source_pins: exact SOURCE_PINS mapping in candidate, generated from bytes
admission.structure_sha256: hash of independently admitted canonical structural projection, not self-admission
admission.prediction_admission_sha256: must equal pinned identity.admission_sha256 of every upstream prediction packet
admission.common_measure_id: nonempty externally fixed identifier for common kappa d_eta in exact eta basis
admission.expected_support_rank: integer 63..283, bool rejected; equals backend rank, no adaptation
admission.authority_boundary: Fields/hashes/reference names are not authorization or physical certificates; trusted caller must review actual references and external release before supplying observed bytes. This package grants none.

backend_receipt.class_module: must match injected callable module metadata
backend_receipt.runtime_reference: id+sha256 referring to caller's verified numpy/runtime inventory
backend_receipt.caller_verification_reference: id+sha256 referring to actual loaded-object verification
backend_receipt.limitation: name/module checks do not authenticate arbitrary objects; trusted caller owns loaded-code provenance

transforms.X_and_mu: already transformed upstream; never apply T again
transforms.offsets: canonical native equations already contain offsets such as alpha+5 and m110-M110_table; no reapplication
transforms.compression: caller admits fixed reduction and full normalization; no inference from absent cross-covariance

support.fixed_affine: caller pins origin; require each mu-origin_out in covariance support before all five likelihoods
support.X: qualified backend requires all 63 columns inside support and full whitened rank
support.outside_residual: backend returns log_integral=-inf with explicit ZERO_DENSITY_OUTSIDE_FIXED_AFFINE_SUPPORT; retained as genuine density zero in admitted measure
support.engineering_failure: exception, not -inf; abort complete five-model call; never omit model
support.tolerance: explicit engineering float64 choice, not a scientific certificate; no jitter/fallback/rank repair

measure.eta: common kappa d_eta on same R^63 basis, log(kappa) omitted
measure.data: Euclidean measure on transformed fixed affine support
measure.normalization: all backend prefactors retained, not dropped
measure.unit_conversion: no ambient det(T) correction on singular support; native density conversion requires support Jacobian outside API

output.log_integral_deta: pointwise Python finite float or legitimate -inf, not logZ
output.preserved: complete family, rank/prefactor, support diagnostics, params/prior metadata, source/assembly/admission/C_out pins
output.serialization: external strict JSON encoder must explicitly label -inf, no implicit NaN serialization

delivery_activity.allowed: read, AST, hashes, structural metadata only

future_review: independent review and separate ROOT decision; not a campaign request or authority
